title: Stabilize real-time features, fix animation disappearance, improve Market Intel accuracy, persist Alerts, and expand content/theme consistency

requirements.text: Fix React Query client duplication by ensuring the app uses a single QueryClientProvider instance so caching, refetching, and invalidation behave consistently across all pages (including Market Intel and real-time sections).

quotes: fix everything which is in real time fix all minor bugs

acceptanceCriteria: The app has exactly one active QueryClientProvider at runtime (no nested providers).
React Query cache keys (e.g., ['marketIntelligence'], ['binarySignal'], ['marketIntelAccess']) are shared consistently across routes and do not reset unexpectedly when navigating.

requirements.text: Fix UI animation/transition behavior that causes content to disappear when users click or interact with page content (e.g., cards/sections becoming opacity-0 or translating away after state changes). Update animation patterns so interactive content remains visible and readable during and after clicks, while keeping motion effects where they do not hide content.

quotes: when I click on any content it disappears due to animations so fix it

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking/tapping content cards, buttons, tabs, and navigation items does not cause the clicked section/card to become invisible (opacity: 0) or collapse unexpectedly.
Whitepaper chapter navigation does not cause the target section to render hidden after clicking a chapter (no blank content caused by transition state).
Motion respects reduced-motion preferences (no mandatory hide-then-reveal for core content).

requirements.text: Stabilize Market Intel unlock + data loading so Market Intel reliably loads after unlock and does not frequently show 'Failed to load market data' due to avoidable client-side issues. Improve error reporting so failures distinguish between access/auth problems vs external market API failures.

quotes: market intel is not working properly so fix it and accurate

acceptanceCriteria: After entering a valid passcode and unlocking, selecting an asset and timeframe triggers a successful fetch attempt and renders results when external APIs respond successfully.
If external APIs fail/rate-limit, the UI displays a clear error state that indicates the cause (API failure) and provides a working retry action.
Unlock/lock actions do not leave the Market Intel page stuck in an incorrect locked/unlocked state due to stale cache.

requirements.text: Improve Market Intel 'accuracy' and consistency by removing or clearly isolating simulated/randomized market inputs used in real-time calculations (especially forex 24h change/volume simulation and Date.now-seeded randomness in indicator/signal generation). Ensure signals are stable for the same asset/timeframe over a short window and are derived from fetched market data wherever possible.

quotes: market intel is not working properly so fix it and accurate

acceptanceCriteria: Market Intel signals (standard + binary) do not change on every refresh solely due to randomness when the underlying fetched market data is unchanged or nearly unchanged.

Forex market metrics displayed/used in calculations are not generated from pure randomness; if the upstream API cannot provide a metric, it is either omitted from calculations or clearly marked as unavailable in the UI.
Indicator generation does not rely on Date.now-based seeding for its core values.

requirements.text: Make Alerts Center 'work properly' by making alerts persistent per authenticated user: add backend storage and CRUD endpoints for alerts, and update the frontend Alerts Center page to use React Query hooks backed by the canister so alerts do not reset on refresh and behave consistently across sessions/devices for the same Internet Identity.
acceptanceCriteria: Creating an alert persists it; after a full page refresh, the alert list remains unchanged.
Toggling status and deleting an alert persists and is reflected after refresh.
Alerts are scoped to the authenticated principal (a different Internet Identity does not see another user’s alerts).
UI shows a clear empty state when no alerts exist, and shows loading/error states while fetching/saving.

requirements.text: Expand the Whitepaper with more topics/chapters and deeper content while preserving the existing chapter navigation UX. Add additional chapters beyond the current list and ensure each new chapter has complete English content (headings, paragraphs, and any supporting bullet lists) consistent with the site’s institutional DeFi tone.
acceptanceCriteria: Whitepaper chapter list includes multiple new chapters (not just minor edits to existing ones).
Clicking each chapter scrolls to a visible section with content (no blank/hidden sections).
The active chapter highlight updates correctly while scrolling through both existing and new chapters.

requirements.text: Apply and complete the intended visual theme consistency updates across Insights, Testimonials, Security/Transparency, Community Highlights, and Ecosystem Growth pages so these sections feel fully updated and aligned (typography, spacing, card styling, background treatment, hover states, and motion behavior). Do not remove existing content; restyle and enhance cohesively.

quotes: theme of insight testimonials security highlight and ecosystem section isn't changed so do it

acceptanceCriteria: Insights, Testimonials, Security/Transparency, Community Highlights, and Ecosystem Growth share a consistent design language (background, card style, headings, and buttons).
No page appears visually 'older' or mismatched compared to the others (consistent use of the same core layout primitives and styling tokens).

requirements.text: Add additional new content sections (at developer discretion) to enrich the site experience without breaking existing navigation or functionality. New sections must be English-only, match the existing product domain (institutional DeFi hub / market intel / community), and be integrated into existing pages (do not require new backend services).

quotes: add more sections on your own

acceptanceCriteria: At least 2 new, clearly labeled sections are added to appropriate existing pages (e.g., Insights/Testimonials/Security/Ecosystem/Home) without removing current sections.
New sections follow the same styling system and do not introduce broken links or empty routes.

requirements.text: Audit and fix site-wide real-time and live-update behaviors (Market Pulse, AI sentiment simulations, Market Intel refresh intervals, timers, and any periodic UI updates) to ensure intervals/timeouts are cleaned up, loading states are correct, and updates do not cause UI flicker, disappearing content, or excessive network calls.

quotes: fix everything which is in real time

acceptanceCriteria: Periodic updates do not create duplicate intervals after navigation or re-renders.
Real-time sections show stable UI (no flicker/disappear) during refresh cycles.
Network requests for auto-refresh do not multiply unexpectedly over time.

constraints: Backend must remain a single-actor Motoko canister; do not introduce additional backend services.

Do not edit any frontend files under frontend immutable paths (including frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui). Compose around them if changes are needed.
Use English for all user-facing text.
nonGoals: Removing Market Intel passcode gating entirely (keep existing access model unless explicitly requested later).
Adding third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity is supported).
Adding WebSockets or true real-time streaming; improvements must use existing polling/interval patterns.
